name: What is the cheapest ADU layout that still looks high-end?

mainEntity.name: What is the cheapest ADU layout that still looks high-end in a luxury neighborhood?
mainEntity.text: What is the cheapest ADU layout that still looks high-end in a luxury neighborhood?

acceptedAnswer.text: A budget-conscious ADU can still look premium if the architecture is simple and well-proportioned. Rectangular or near-rectangular plans are usually the most cost-efficient because they reduce framing complexity, roof transitions, and exterior corners. A compact wet core with the kitchen, bath, and laundry grouped together helps reduce plumbing costs. The exterior can still feel upscale through good window placement, clean lines, quality siding, and thoughtful lighting. In luxury neighborhoods, the design should also match the main home in scale and character without trying to imitate it too literally. The key is to spend money where it matters most: structure, envelope, windows, and durable finishes. Homeowners should avoid expensive shapes that add little to the living experience. A simple plan with strong architectural detailing usually outperforms a complicated plan with a larger budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: The most cost-efficient high-end ADU is usually a simple rectangular plan with a compact kitchen and bath core, standard structural spans, and limited roof complexity. High-end appearance comes from proportions, windows, materials, and detailing, not from an expensive or complicated footprint.
